answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the thread is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the bridge of a task receipt, and the umber is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
